title: Capacity Knowledge Object (Schema v2 — universal core + module overlay)
$comment: NON-EXECUTABLE structural schema for future capacity-knowledge metadata. Unknown top-level fields are disallowed (additionalProperties:false). Supports two object types: universal_capacity (CAP-###, module:universal) and module_capacity_overlay (e.g. RF-CAP-###, module:rf) which references its universal core via universal_capacity_ref. A capacity object is INERT metadata describing a human capacity and how it connects to assessments (measured_by), exercises (improved_by), activities (expressed_through), demand profiles (required_by), and rehab plan blocks. Capacity knowledge is represented as evidence_state (epistemic) + goal_sufficiency_status (sufficiency vs goal) + confidence_status — never a numeric score, threshold, pass/fail decision, timeline, dosage, prescription, progression / readiness / RTT / RTS / clearance authority. Objects must remain draft/pending, clinically not approved, non-executable, runtime-disconnected, and metadata-only.

capacity_id.description: Universal capacity id (CAP-###) or module overlay id (RF-CAP-###). Empty string permitted only in the blank template.

universal_capacity_ref.description: For module_capacity_overlay objects, the universal CAP-### this overlay refines. Empty string for universal_capacity objects and the blank template.

measured_by_assessment_categories.description: Assessment-purpose categories that MEASURE this capacity. References only; never a clearance decision.

improved_by_exercise_function_categories.description: Exercise-function categories that IMPROVE this capacity. References only; never a prescription.

expressed_through_activity_domains.description: Activity-exposure domains that EXPRESS this capacity. References only.

required_by_demand_profiles.description: Sport-demand categories that REQUIRE this capacity. References only.

evidence_state.description: Epistemic state: how well the capacity is known. NOT a numeric score.

goal_sufficiency_status.description: Sufficiency relative to the person's current goal. Evidence about adequacy, NOT a pass/fail decision and NOT clearance.

confidence_status.description: Qualitative confidence. NOT a numeric score.

allowed_when.description: Inert metadata context only. Never a runtime-selection trigger.
